slides.title: We listen and we don't judge.
slides.body: Restaurant owners, Thanksgiving week edition. Go:

slides.title: "I know our health permit is on the wall. I could not tell you when it expires."
slides.body: It's behind the framed first dollar. Probably.

slides.title: "Half my holiday hires said they have food handler cards. I believed them."
"Our liquor license renewal is in an inbox nobody has opened since summer."
slides.body: The password is on a sticky note in the walk-in. Somewhere.

slides.title: "I renewed the same license twice because I didn't trust that I'd done it."
slides.body: Peace of mind is not cheap.

slides.label: No judgment.
slides.title: Just maybe a reminder this time.
slides.body: Before the dinner rush, not during it.

slides.title: CertTrack keeps every permit, license and policy date in one place.
slides.body: And alerts you before anything expires.
